requirements.description: Daily + manual GitHub Action fetches the yannworks contribution calendar (GraphQL) into a JSON file next to the page (date, count, level per day, total, fetch time) and commits only when the data changed; the page reads it
Uses the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN; if it cannot read the calendar, stop and tell Yann (fallback: fine-grained token as a repository secret, never in code)
Totals roughly match the GitHub profile (private contributions included as counts); tell Yann if clearly lower
Page tested with sample data; sample data never published as real; graph section hidden until the real file exists
After publishing: workflow run once (or Yann told where to tap Run workflow) and the live graph checked with real data
If the workflow push is refused or the Action cannot commit, Yann gets the exact setting to change or the file to add on the website
Each day is a 4x4-dot square with Bayer-ordered dots: 1 faint dot for no contributions, 2/4/8/16 dots for levels 1-4; ink on paper following the theme; whole-pixel dots
Summary line above the graph in the page style, the number in Geist Serif
Desktop shows 53 weeks with the year total; phone shows the last 26 weeks with 'in the last 6 months' and that period's total
Section placed where it fits best in the page order, reason given
First time in view, the graph fills in dot by dot in Bayer order up to each level, about 1 s, once
Hover or tap a day shows one line under the graph; keyboard focus as one element with arrow keys; screen readers get the summary and the selected day
Tiny animated Clawd on today's column, only colour in the graph, from the approved grids and loops; readable at phone width without hiding the graph; cells match the dots
After the fill: Clawd walks along the top edge from the left to today, turns front, settles, idles with blinks and small bounces; tap or hover gives a happy bounce
Clawd settles after about 10 s and only moves again when tapped; pauses off screen and on a hidden tab
Reduced motion: no walk, Clawd already on today, blinks and bounces in place; shorter dissolve for the graph

Edge cases: missing or broken file hides the section; data older than 3 days shows 'updated <date>'; without JS a plain 'See my activity on GitHub' link; no contributions today still puts Clawd on today
Graph on board.html, README explains the Action and running it by hand, decisions in .web-craft
Regression: no console errors, no horizontal scroll, contrast passing; scene, themes, dissolve unchanged
Screenshots with sample data at 390 and 1440 px, light and dark, normal and reduced motion
MP4 recording of the graph filling in and Clawd walking to today
